heroHeadline: Bihar's exam-protest wave forces a concession: TRE-4 goes single-phase after Patna police clash with BPSC aspirants
heroSubtitle: Thousands of Bihar Public Service Commission and teacher-recruitment aspirants clashed with police in Patna on Aug 25 after marching toward Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary's residence, prompting water cannons and a lathi-charge and coming two days after the exam controller's suspension over a viral 'dogs bark' remark; Choudhary then conceded a single-phase TRE-4 exam and a judge-led reforms panel on Aug 27, while Jharkhand's JPSC exam-rigging case remains before the Supreme Court and the original NEET-era Delhi street movement stays wound down since July
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
